novelty_basis: Covered by the complete characterization of Zantema and Geser (RTA 1995 / AAECC 2000); our proof was found independently.
proof_check: written proof (proofs/paper/C03.md Theorem 2, induction over zeros from the right); swap case (s, r) = (p, q) Lean-verified (terminating_swap); 62 of the 64 conserving rules with parameters <= 4 also have matrix-interpretation certificates; awaiting independent skeptic review
statement:
The rule 0^p 1^q -> 1^r 0^s terminates whenever s = p or r = q. For (s, r) = (p, q) the number of (0,1)
inversions drops by pq at each step.
title: Conserving rules terminate (s = p or r = q)
